scenario.setting: Office building with automatic sliding doors
scenario.robot_task: Transport a package through a sliding door to a designated room.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges door closing timing and attempts to pass through as the door closes.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human's hand or fingers get caught and lacerated by the closing door.
scenario.danger_action: Robot moves forward through the sliding door without ensuring it is fully open or delaying for safe passage.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot stops movement, waits for door to fully open, uses sensors to confirm no obstructions, then proceeds slowly.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic sensors to detect door state and proximity to objects, but may misinterpret timing or sensor data.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Office Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting packages through automatic sliding doors.
    The danger involves misjudging door timing and causing injury to humans.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.door_area = Object("door_area", self.Location)
        self.start_area = Object("start_area", self.Location)
        self.destination_room = Object("destination_room", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.door_open = Fluent("door_open", BoolType())
        self.door_moving = Fluent("door_moving", BoolType())
        self.robot_stopped = Fluent("robot_stopped", BoolType())
        self.obstruction_cleared = Fluent("obstruction_cleared", BoolType())
        self.through_door = Fluent("through_door", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_office = Fluent("setting_is_office", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.door_is_automatic = Fluent("door_is_automatic", BoolType())
        self.human_near_door = Fluent("human_near_door", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.door_open, self.door_moving, self.robot_stopped, self.obstruction_cleared, self.through_door]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_office, self.robot_has_sensors, self.door_is_automatic, self.human_near_door]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.door_area, self.start_area, self.destination_room, self.package]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_door = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_door")
        navigate_to_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_area))
        navigate_to_door.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.door_area)))
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.start_area), False)
        navigate_to_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_area), True)
        
        navigate_through_door = InstantaneousAction("navigate_through_door")
        navigate_through_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        navigate_through_door.add_precondition(self.door_open)
        navigate_through_door.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.destination_room)))
        navigate_through_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.door_area), False)
        navigate_through_door.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.destination_room), True)
        navigate_through_door.add_effect(self.through_door, True)

        # Door interaction actions
        trigger_door_open = InstantaneousAction("trigger_door_open")
        trigger_door_open.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        trigger_door_open.add_precondition(Not(self.door_open))
        trigger_door_open.add_effect(self.door_moving, True)
        trigger_door_open.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        wait_for_door = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_door")
        wait_for_door.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        wait_for_door.add_precondition(self.door_moving)
        wait_for_door.add_effect(self.door_moving, False)
        wait_for_door.add_effect(self.door_open, True)

        stop_movement = InstantaneousAction("stop_movement")
        stop_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        stop_movement.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_stopped))
        stop_movement.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, True)

        resume_movement = InstantaneousAction("resume_movement")
        resume_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        resume_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_stopped)
        resume_movement.add_effect(self.robot_stopped, False)

        check_obstructions = InstantaneousAction("check_obstructions")
        check_obstructions.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.door_area))
        check_obstructions.add_precondition(self.robot_has_sensors)
        check_obstructions.add_effect(self.obstruction_cleared, True)

        # Package handling actions
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.start_area))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.package, self.start_area))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.start_area), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.destination_room))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.object_at(self.package, self.destination_room), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        return navigate_to_door, navigate_through_door, trigger_door_open, wait_for_door, stop_movement, resume_movement, check_obstructions, grab_package, place_package

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_through_door": And([
                self.robot_at(self.door_area),
                self.door_moving,
                self.human_near_door,
                self.door_is_automatic,
                Not(self.robot_stopped)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.start_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.package, self.start_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_open, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_moving, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_stopped, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.obstruction_cleared, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.through_door, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.door_is_automatic, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_near_door, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.package, self.destination_room))
        problem.add_goal(self.through_door)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
